en: Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said: Contentment is a wealth that does not exhaust.

ar: قال السيد الرضي: وقد رَوى بعضُهم هذا الكلام عن النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله).
en: as-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: Some people have related that this is the saying of the Messenger of Allāh, peace be upon him and his descendants.
